name: Guide arm: 4 then 7 Hz bilateral sine (Gateway Focus 15)
origin: This app's Gateway-style guides (our design; no published protocol)
summary: The coil arm of this project's Gateway-style Focus 15 guide: a 4 Hz in-phase sine on all temporal coils for 11 min, then 7 Hz for up to 22 min, at 2 uT. It is this project's own design and untested. The Gateway documents describe sound only and give no frequency for Focus 15; the 7 Hz is the binaural beat of an audio study (Wahbeh 2007).
source: Our design after the Gateway research notes; Wahbeh et al. 2007, J Altern Complement Med 13:199 (7 Hz layer); Shakti safety page https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/winshakti/safety.htm
notes: The Gateway method is sound through stereo headphones (McDonnell 1983 p.8). Focus 15 is described only as reached 'through the inclusion of additional levels of sound on the Hemi-Sync tapes' (McDonnell 1983 p.25). No Gateway document gives a frequency for Focus 15, and none of those this project holds describes magnetic or electrical stimulation. The 7 Hz is the binaural beat of Wahbeh 2007, an audio study ('at 7 Hz (carrier frequencies: 133 Hz L; 140Hz R)', p.1). This program plays a sine on all temporal coils in phase: 4 Hz for 11 min (the steps in the style of Focus 10 and Focus 12), then 7 Hz (count 13 to 15 and open awareness, 12 min of steps). The 7 Hz phase lasts 22 min, 10 min longer than its steps, so that a paused guide does not cut it short: the helmet keeps running while the guide is paused, and the guide stops the program after its last arm step. A pause still moves the switch to 7 Hz ahead of the steps it belongs to. The coil arm has no source: carrying audio beat rates over to a magnetic field is this project's choice. No source states a field strength, because none used a field; the 2 uT is this project's choice. This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. Nobody has tested this arm. The only cited statement on the combination is a vendor's advice against it (Shakti safety page, rule 2: do not combine Shakti with other mind machines in real time). Run it blinded, real against sham, from the guide.
